rules.condition: PM-JAY eligibility is based on SECC deprivation criteria, automatic inclusion categories, defined occupational categories, and certain existing RSBY beneficiary families.

notes: The current profile does not collect the SECC deprivation criteria, automatic-inclusion status, qualifying urban occupation, or RSBY beneficiary status required to determine PM-JAY eligibility.
The category field cannot safely be used as a proxy for these PM-JAY eligibility criteria.
No income threshold rule is added because the source eligibility criteria are not represented by the current income field.
